description: Result.completed_at (the per-result merge tiebreaker for resumed/partial runs, Discussion #10) is an RFC 3339 date-time. An offset-less local time such as "2026-09-29T00:00:05" (what Python's datetime.isoformat() produces for a naive datetime) has no defined instant, so two partial ResultSets written on machines in different time zones could not be merged reliably. RFC 3339 requires the offset. A conformance implementation MUST REJECT this document (reference validators: INVALID_DATE_TIME).
